meta.title: Tech+RFQ: Technical response after the technical stage ended

plan.title: Technical response is read-only after stage end

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its Technical stage; this must be the first step for the prepared state.
Move to Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Technical response in the vendor portal.

args.goal: on the vendor's Technical response screen after the Technical stage has ended, try to change an existing answer and stop when the screen proves the answer is read-only and unchanged

steps.note: Interact with the technical answer and verify that no change can be made after the stage ended.
